name: Every Woman Counts
description: Every Woman Counts provides free breast and cervical cancer screenings to uninsured and underinsured California women, helping detect cancer early when treatment is most effective.
fullDescription: Every Woman Counts provides free breast and cervical cancer screenings to uninsured and underinsured California women, helping detect cancer early when treatment is most effective.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free mammograms
- Clinical breast exams
- Pap tests (cervical cancer screening)
- HPV tests
- Follow-up diagnostic testing if needed
- Connection to free treatment through the Breast and Cervical Cancer Treatment Program (BCCTP)
- Available at providers statewide (online provider locator)
- Help available in English, Spanish, and many other languages
howToGetIt: Call 1-800-511-2300 (24/7) or use the online provider locator to find a provider and check eligibility. You must be a California resident with income at or below 200% of the federal poverty level and uninsured or underinsured for these services. Cervical screening is for ages 21+; breast screening is for ages 40+ (any age if high risk).
keywords: Every Woman Counts, mammogram, breast cancer, cervical cancer, Pap test, HPV test, free screening, cancer detection, BCCTP, uninsured women
